jobs.description:
Take ownership of scalable web applications, shape technical architecture and build robust solutions with PHP, Symfony & Vue.js.

Our partner is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen its development team.

You will work on scalable web applications, contribute to key architectural decisions and take ownership of technical topics across the stack.

The position combines hands-on development with architecture, code quality and knowledge sharing in a collaborative environment.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications with PHP & Symfony at the core.
• Contribute to system architecture and solution design, focusing on security, performance, scalability and maintainability.
• Develop APIs and integrations, including asynchronous communication patterns.
• Work across the stack on backend services with PHP/Symfony and frontend features with Vue.js.
• Implement automated testing and collaborate on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Profile
• You have 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer.
• You have strong expertise in PHP & Symfony and a solid understanding of web architecture, design patterns and best practices.
• You are comfortable with MySQL/PostgreSQL, caching solutions and asynchronous or distributed systems concepts.
• You have experience with GitLab CI/CD, modern DevOps practices and Docker.
• You have experience with automated testing and bring strong problem-solving skills in collaborative, agile environments.
• You communicate confidently in English.
• Knowledge of TypeScript, Vue.js or Python is considered an asset.

New year, new challenges!Join a structured manufacturing company in Brussels where you can grow professionally, improve your skills, and make an impact.

Our partner, a leadingmanufacturing company in Belgium, is looking for aSystem Administratorto join their IT team of talented engineers. 

 

A multicultural environment where you will be coached and trained, all while applying your technical expertise to real-world challenges.

• Install, configure, and maintain workstations, business applications, and IT equipment.

• Support IT projects, system upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.
• Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity policies are up to date.

• Basic to intermediate networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, firewalls).
• Familiarity with backup solutions, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and cybersecurity best practices.
• Customer-focused, proactive, and problem-solving mindset.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
• Fluent in English and French. Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Data & Business Analyst | Help business growing
jobs.description:
Translating data intoactionable insights, reportswhile contributing to the continuous improvement of data-driven decision-making. This job is waiting for you!

Ready to turn data into real business impact?Join an international technology company in Brussels and help transform complex data into meaningful insights that support smarter business decisions.

 

Our partner, aninnovative and growing technology company, is looking for aData Analystto join its team and play a key role in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data across the organization.
Data & Business Analyst - Role & Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and analyze data from multipleinternal and external sourcesto identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.

• Translate business requirements into meaningfuldata analyses, KPIs, and performance indicators.

• Strong proficiency inSQLand experience working with large and complex datasets.
• Hands-on experience withPower BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools.
• Good understanding of data analysis, reporting, KPIs, and data visualization principles.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer | Create real business impact
jobs.description:
Work at the intersection oftechnology, data, and business, identifying opportunities where AI can create value and turning business needs into solutions.

Ready for a new challenge in AI?Join an international technology company in Brussels and contribute to the development of AI solutions that create real business impact.

 

Our partner, aninternational professional company, is looking for anAI Engineerto join its team and contribute to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
AI Engineer - What's the job about
• Design, develop, and deployAI-powered solutionsaddressing real-world business challenges.
• Develop and integrate solutions based onMachine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
• Integrate AI models and services into existing applications, systems, and IT environments.
• Collaborate with IT, data, and business teams to identifyAI and automation opportunitiesacross the organization.
• Develop prototypes and POCs, and transform successful concepts intorobust, scalable, production-ready solutions.
• Work on data pipelines, model evaluation, and the continuous improvement of AI solution performance.

Own the roadmap of a critical provisioning platform, where DNS, IP and partner APIs meet product strategy.

Product Owner | Brussels area

Our client is a major Belgian player in connectivity and digital services, whose in-house teams build and run the platforms behind its network, its domain and IP services and its customer-facing products.

What makes it stand out? A technology organisation large enough to handle infrastructure at national scale, yet structured in product teams where ownership is real and decisions are made close to the work.

The company is modernising its provisioning and service-management platforms, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of services, with resilience, security and compliance as constant constraints.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, own the roadmap and set priorities across these mission-critical platforms.

 

The job

• Define and own the vision, roadmap and priorities of a critical provisioning platform, comparable in logic to OSS/BSS systems.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and partner needs into clear product direction and concrete priorities.
 
Role
• Own the roadmap across the provisioning engine, DNS and IP domain management, partner integration APIs, service lifecycle and data analytics capabilities, making transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
• Work closely with architecture, engineering, service delivery, compliance and security to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the business analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Balance immediate operational needs — run, incidents, service commitments — with platform modernisation, resilience and security.
Profile
• Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or Information Systems.
• Around 7 years of experience in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Hands-on exposure to DNS, IP management, domain lifecycle or similar provisioning and registry protocols is a strong asset.
• Dutch or French with a good command of the other, and professional English.

Looking for a job that truly matters? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 

For a large industrial laundry company in Oedelem, we are looking for a motivated production worker. You will work in a two-shift system or day shift. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Sorting dirty laundry
 
• Hanging clothes/linen on hangers
 
• Placing clothes/linen on the steam ironing table
 
• Checking for wear and tear
 
• Based on your skills and competences, we will determine which production line suits you best. 

For the position of production worker, we are looking for someone with the following qualities:
 

 
• You can work independently
 
• You are able to perform physical work
 
• You can work in a two-shift system or day shift
 
• You speak Dutch, English, French, or another language
 
• You can travel independently to the depot in Oedelem

CE & C Drivers Wanted
 

Do you enjoy being on the road, working with structure, and aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves? Then we have the perfect job for you!
 

For our production site in Oedelem, we are looking for enthusiastic drivers with a C or CE driving licence. You make sure hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks always receive clean linen.
 

Thanks to your work, patients have clean beds, healthcare workers wear fresh uniforms, and holiday guests enjoy a clean and comfortable start to their stay.
 

An important job you can truly be proud of.
 

What does your workday look like?
 

You start between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM with a good cup of coffee and a fully loaded truck.
 

After that:
 

 
• You drive a fixed route to customers in the region
 
• You deliver clean linen
 
• You collect dirty textiles
 
• You return to the laundry facility for the next trip 
 

You complete an average of 6 to 8 trips per day and always work with fixed routes and regular customers.
 

No chaos, just clarity, structure, and routine.

Who are we looking for?
 

You are:
 

 
• In possession of a valid C or CE driving licence
 
• In possession of a valid Code 95 and medical examination
 
• Physically fit and enjoy active work
 
• Dutch-speaking and/or English-speaking and/or French-speaking
 
• Available to work 37.5 hours per week
 
• Living within a maximum of 25 minutes from Oedelem

Time to Take the lead. Own security initiatives, influence technical decisions and become a key voice in your organisation's cybersecurity strategy.

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineerready to combine hands-on expertise with technical leadership. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of security projects, guide improvements and progressively become a go-to expert within the organisation.
Cybersecurity Engineer - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Lead security initiativesby driving the implementation and continuous improvement of cybersecurity measures.
• Assess and mitigate risksby identifying security gaps, evaluating threats and coordinating appropriate remediation actions.
• Improve security controlsacross IT systems, infrastructure and business processes.
• Drive security standards and best practices, contributing to policies, procedures and compliance initiatives.
• Coordinate with IT and business stakeholdersto turn security requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Take technical ownershipof key security topics, influence decisions and help shape the organisation's cybersecurity roadmap.
Cybersecurity Engineer - Profile
• Experience incybersecurity, information security engineering or IT security.
• Solid understanding ofsecurity controls, risk assessment and infrastructure security.
• Familiarity withISO 27001, security governance or regulatory complianceis a plus.
• Ability tolead technical initiatives, coordinate stakeholders and take ownership of complex topics.
• A hands-on, solution-oriented mindset combined with the ambition toinfluence strategy and mentor others.
• Fluency inEnglish and Dutch, French is considered an asset.

Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, and maintain IT and OT network systems to support 24/7 business operations.
• Implement and manage routing and switching protocols across a mostly Cisco-based infrastructure.
• Secure the network environment using advanced firewall technologies and software-defined solutions.
• Develop automation scripts to streamline network operations and configuration management.
• Collaborate with cross-functional ICT teams to provide connectivity and infrastructure support for various projects.
• Participate in a standby rotation to ensure continuous service availability for international stakeholders.

Requirements

• 8+ years experience in routing and switching protocols including OSPF, ISIS, MP-BGP, and MST.
• 8+ years experience with Cisco network hardware including ASR, ISR, Catalyst, and Nexus devices.
• 8+ years experience managing Cisco Wireless infrastructure.
• 8+ years experience with cloud technologies, specifically Microsoft Azure.
• 8+ years experience in network automation using Python or Ansible.
• 8+ years experience with Cisco ACI or Cisco SD-WAN.
• Experience with security technologies including Checkpoint and Palo Alto firewalls.
• Experience with network monitoring and management tools such as NAC and central syslog.
• You possess a background in computer science, a proactive mindset, and are willing to travel within Belgium.
• You are fluent in English with professional proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of TACACS and RADIUS servers.
• Experience with Zabbix, Elastic, or Cisco ISE.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Cloud & HPC Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define and manage integrated project plans including scope, deliverables, budget, and resource allocation.
• Lead high-impact projects involving cloud services, high-performance computing (HPC) platforms, and secure compute environments.
• Act as the primary coordinator for research stakeholders, architects, security teams, and external partners.
• Manage infrastructure modernization, system integrations, and large-scale migration initiatives.
• Establish agreements regarding service ownership, support responsibilities, and operational models.
• Identify and mitigate delivery risks while ensuring adherence to quality and acceptance criteria.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience managing complex Cloud, Infrastructure, Datacenter, or HPC projects.
• You possess a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
• You're able to translate between research needs and technical, security, and operational requirements.
• You bring advanced skills in project planning, organization, and outcome-oriented risk management.
• You possess the technical understanding of secure environments necessary to challenge plans and coordinate specialists.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• 8+ years of experience with Cloud adoption, platform modernization, or compute-intensive environments.
• Previous experience working in highly secure infrastructure environments.

Responsibilities

• Design, configure, and optimize the Elastic Security platform to collect and correlate security event data.
• Integrate log data from a predefined list of systems and applications into the ELK stack.
• Develop and maintain security-focused dashboards and reports using Kibana to meet organizational needs.
• Execute platform upgrades and ensure the scalability and reliability of the SIEM infrastructure.
• Integrate threat intelligence feeds into Elasticsearch for proactive hunting and incident detection.
• Monitor security logs and alerts across cloud and on-premise environments to identify anomalies.
• Document technical procedures, system diagrams, and delivery artifacts to support security operations.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in security engineering with a focus on SIEM and the Elastic Stack (Kibana, Logstash, Kafka).
• You possess 3+ years of experience managing both Linux and Windows operating systems.
• You bring expertise in Elasticsearch, including data indexing, querying, and visualization techniques.
• You have experience integrating security logs within cloud environments such as AWS and Azure.
• You possess knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, API scripting, or ES/QL.
• You have experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), network security, and intrusion detection tools.
• You bring familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as SOC2 or ISO 27001.
• You have experience working with cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes.
• You're proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in incident response scenarios.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with the Elastic APM (Application Performance Monitoring) module.
• Knowledge of Elastic Agent and various beats collectors.
• Active knowledge of English.
